name: Atharv Kamble
tagline: Visual stories shaped by light, movement and place.
bio: Working between observation, movement, computation, and brand architecture. Based in India — capturing still frames, directing films, engineering high-retention video edits, co-founding Paper Media, and investigating computational image systems in AI / ML.

arc.detail: Medium format stills, architectural shadow, monsoon tones
Atmospheric motion, documentary pacing, cinematic lighting
Rhythm, sound design, precision color timing, narrative arc
Brand presence, viral content strategy, social distribution
Computer vision, generative models, pixel data theory
